calls.title: GLS/NXT + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The call discussed GrowthBook’s experimentation platform, featuring flag-based A/B testing, a visual editor for no-code changes, and warehouse-native analytics connecting to BigQuery—addressing GLS/NXT’s pain points of lacking A/B testing, heavy developer dependency, and needing faster iteration and clear experiment results. Key participants included Christian, Jeremy, and Logan from GrowthBook (sales, technical lead, engineering) and Matthias (product designer), Unnati (data), Dirk and Noah (product owners), and Anuj (development) from GLS/NXT. Next steps: Christian will share the recording and documentation, then follow up with Matthias early next week (or tomorrow) to discuss next steps.

calls.title: GLS/NXT + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The GLSNext team evaluated GrowthBook as an experimentation platform to enhance product iterations and reduce dependencies on engineering resources. GrowthBook's features include flexible feature flags for simple toggling of new features, complex audience segmentation through targeting rules, and a safe rollout process that allows for gradual testing with automated rollback capabilities. The platform also offers advanced experiment result analysis tools like metric drilling by dimensions, real-time alerts, customizable dashboards, and seamless integration with BigQuery for data analytics. A significant emphasis was placed on enabling product teams to independently test hypotheses with low-code/no-code setups while maintaining GDPR compliance. The meeting concluded with plans for further collaboration and follow-up resources.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, feature flags, BigQuery integration, experimentation, product analytics
